elements.text: Gaps
← Overview

What the site needs that Alchemy's Web canvas and recipe format can't express yet. Each is a one-line to-do for Alchemy; you decide which become work. projects/star-survey.json uses workarounds meanwhile.
Layout
Backdrop layer
A page-wide live background under the grid (the WebGL sky, a canvas, a video).
built: CSS backdrop + a live one (WebGL sky: nebula, stars; or a video)
Fixed overlay slots
Blocks pinned to the viewport corners/edges (rail, comms, readout, orb, HUD), outside the grid flow.
built: pins (8 spots, per-tier spot, keep-clear edge)
In-place sections
One page with states switched by #hash, with an enter/exit transition, instead of a route per section.
built: Home shows the six pages in place (#hash, :target, rise-in)
Content bounds
A block that fills between two fixed slots and scrolls inside (max-height from the viewport).
built: bounded blocks scroll inside, screen-high
Recipe format
Per-variant states
Hover/press styles inside a variant option (action glows gold, quiet signal, danger ember).
built: action gold, quiet signal, danger ember (option states)
Text transform + fonts
text-transform: uppercase; a font-loading head entry (Rajdhani, Inter, JetBrains Mono).
built: textTransform + the project’s fonts in the head
Backdrop filter
backdrop-filter: blur(4px) on a part (the frost).
built: backdropBlur (the frame’s 4px frost)
Decorations
Corner ticks (pseudo-element parts) and dashed borders.
built: ticks + tickColor (::before), borderStyle dashed/dotted
Structured list items
List items with more than text fields: tags (a nested list), links (label + href) — the Entry shape.
built: lists inside list items (repeat item.tags), edited as "a | b, …"
Reduced motion
A calm variant of transitions under prefers-reduced-motion.
built: calm under prefers-reduced-motion (fades only)
Behaviors & effects
Leader line
An SVG line between two placed parts, measured at runtime, redrawn on resize.
built: leader behavior (45° elbow, draws in; Menu + Detail ≥1024)
Press burst
An effect component: the 8-petal paper ring on press, clipped to the part.
built: burst (8 petals, role color, clipped; calm: rim flash)
Orb stick
A pointer-driven control (stick + ring zones + side button) emitting events other parts listen to.
built: orb stick (Controls set) + orb behavior; on Home
Alive glow
A state set by a behavior (selected, open, speaking) that drives a glow.
built: alive state + behavior (always / section / focus)

knowledge.text: Bridge 2026-11-19: vault/palettes/star-survey.json (11 colors) and projects/star-survey.json (6 pages, theme from the decided tokens, 5 components: Button, Frame, Menu + Detail, Entry list, Rail + comms). Every page exports to HTML/TSX; /live/star-survey/work serves.
14 gaps between this site and the Web canvas / recipe format, grouped as layout, recipe format, behaviors & effects. None is built from site-survey; the user picks which become Alchemy work.

Built 2026-11-19 (batch 1): per-variant states, text transform + project fonts, backdrop filter, reduced motion. projects/star-survey.json uses them: button option hovers, uppercase labels, frame frost, Rajdhani/Inter/JetBrains Mono.

Built 2026-11-19 (batch 2): pinned blocks (fixed to the viewport outside <main>, a spot per tier, `reserve` keeps the edge clear), bounded blocks (scroll inside, max-height from the viewport), a CSS backdrop under every page. star-survey: rail pinned top (56 clear), Play’s info readout bottom-left, reading frames bounded, a night-sky gradient backdrop.

Built 2026-11-19 (batch 3): lists inside list items (an Entry’s tags and links), corner ticks and dashed borders, links to the current page marked aria-current="page" in the export and preview. star-survey: entries split into title / meta / body / tags (links wait on the URLs), Education & Skills as five entries, ticks on frames, menus, entries and the LINKS panel; the rail on phones is dots + the current label + one LINKS button (comms: RÉSUMÉ, GitHub, Contact).

Built 2026-11-19: in-place sections. A page lists other pages (`sections`); the export puts each one’s grid on it as <section id>, switched by :target with a rise-in (a fade when calm), links to them become #hash, and a small script keeps aria-current on the rail link of the section showing. star-survey: Home (/) = the pinned rail + the six pages; the brand goes to /. A section’s own pinned blocks stay on its standalone page (Play’s info readout).

Built 2026-11-19 (batch 4): an `alive` state (data-alive) and an `alive` behavior that sets it (always, while its section shows, while focus is inside; other runtimes may set it too); a `burst` behavior (8 petals from the press point in the part's line color or data-colors, clipped, ≤ .7, 500ms, one at a time; calm: one rim flash, at most 3 a second; keyboard presses burst from the middle); in-place sections step by arrows / PageUp-Down, one wheel gesture and a vertical swipe, through the hash, waiting while something can still scroll. star-survey: every Button bursts; LAUNCH is always alive (gold glow); Button and Frame take an `alive` prop; Play's info readout is alive while its section shows.

Built 2026-11-19 (batch 5): a `leader` behavior — a 1px line from `from` (default the selected tab) to `to` (default the panel showing), looked up in the component then the page; it leaves sideways and meets the near edge level, or with one 45° elbow, in the start's color (gold off a selected row) unless `leader-color`; draws in over 300ms on the standard ease when its ends change (whole when calm); redrawn on resize, selection, scroll and hash changes; nothing when the two are stacked or the screen is under `leader-min`. star-survey: Menu + Detail (Work, Projects, Open Source) from 1024 up.

Built 2026-11-19 (batch 6): an Orb stick recipe (new Controls set: ring, disc = button 1's real button, ring-top button 2, side button, a dial label) and an `orb` behavior. Zones by where the pointer goes down (70% radius = stick, tap under 250ms / 6px = button 1; ring ±50° of the top = button 2); every zone is a real labelled button for keys. It sends a bubbling, cancelable `orb` event (stick x/y/mag with a 0.12 dead zone, aim, go, release, button1, button2, side); unless a listener takes it over, in site mode the stick dials the page's sections (notches round the ring, the aimed one named, release goes there), button 1 presses the section's lit button (LAUNCH) or opens the next tab or scrolls a step, button 2 goes back; pressed zones light and vibrate 10ms. A drag on it never swipes sections. star-survey: on Home, pinned bottom-right in one column (the orb overflows leftward at full size): gold disc, signal ring button, flame side button 'C'. Not yet: per-tier exact sizes (136 / 168 / 200 is a clamp on screen width), the safe-area inset, the mirror, Cori's lines.

Built 2026-11-19 (batch 7): live backdrops — a project's or page's `live` (sky, video, or off on a page), drawn fixed under the page over the CSS backdrop, which stays as the fallback (no script, no WebGL, before the first frame). The sky is a WebGL nebula and twinkling stars in four colors (night, nebula, glow, stars; var(--color-…) works), with star density and drift; ≤ 30 fps at ¾ resolution, stopped in a hidden tab, one still frame when calm, aria-hidden. A video ships muted and looping without autoplay (its poster holds without script and when calm). Addresses must be a site path or https. Set in Project settings or a page's fields; the Web preview runs the same runtime. star-survey: the sky in void / plum / wine / cream (the nebula stays at or under ≈#3a2440, where Accessibility measured the frames). Not the game's sky: fireworks, characters and the real star map stay in the game.

Built 2026-11-22 (batch 8, components pass): a `projection` behavior (scanline rings + a pulse from [data-role="orb"] behind a part's contents, its edge shimmering through shared SVG noise filters near / mid / far, pulses every 12 s, on hashchange, on appear and on `al-projection-pulse`; still when calm) and component widths in recipes (`responsive["1248"]`: a container query beside the tiers; Fabricator edits an existing one). star-survey: Button (action / quiet; danger gone) and Frame (new tone plate) projected; Menu + Detail side by side from a 1248 content area (= a 1280 screen) with its leader from 1280; the orb's side button is ?; a new Cori's plate (mood dot + C.O-R.I eyebrow in neutral signal / happy gold / curious flame / alert ember, a polite live region, alive, projected) pinned right on Home.

Gap: placements switch only at the three tiers (600 / 1024). The site wants Menu + Detail from 1280 and the Entry list (rows open in place) below; today 1024–1280 shows the pair stacked, menu over detail. Needs a per-project layout width or a placement shown from a width.
Gap: behaviors attach to a component's root. The rail's projection belongs on its line, not the whole header strip, so the rail isn't projected yet. Needs a behavior on a part (a data-role target).
Gap: Fabricator lists a component's width breakpoints once they exist but can't add one (written in the file for now).

Not in Alchemy's reach yet: the orb's states (transmitter load, docked with the moth in his tank, field down, recall), the cocoon and space-on load, Cori flying, landing, touring and typing, and her leader to the butterfly. The site's own code builds those; Cori's plate is the static piece, and her landings can fire `al-projection-pulse`.

agent.brief: A to-do list for Alchemy itself, not for the site. Don't build any of these from site-survey.
